data.short_meaning: Tower of strength, tower of Magdalene
data.long_meaning: Madelon is derived from the Hebrew name 'Migdal', which means 'tower'. In the Bible, Mary Magdalene is often referred to as 'Mary of Magdala' and is associated with a tower. In Christian tradition, she is a symbol of strength and devotion. The name Madelon carries the meaning “Tower of strength, tower of Magdalene” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Madelon usually hope their child will grow to embody tower of strength, tower of magdalene and live with faith, good character and purpose.
